corrections: EnergyChanged uses change and draw is cardDrawn. Engine prompt log records contain source/card UUID/role but not ability; the prompt itself preserves ability 0.
resolveChosenEffect chooses child targets before its body, so the failing fixture uses a later opposing discard prompt after draw/reveal to expose a real published prefix.
Rollback retains published identities already in hand; a transient draw cannot expose its committed deck position. A corrupt unreplayable answer cannot reconstruct a published identity.
A deliberately mismatched fingerprint is created by the public typed promptFingerprint helper with a structurally complete cancellable:false prompt.
